written.headline: United Airlines bars unauthorized AI agents from booking travel
written.summary: United Airlines barred unauthorized third-party AI agents from booking, purchasing, or servicing travel through its digital platforms. The airline cited data privacy risks, account security concerns, and potential violations of FAA and DOT regulations.

written.headline: Anthropic IPO draws multiple times the orders for available shares
written.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering has drawn multiple times the orders for available shares. The Claude maker is reportedly planning a livestreamed marketing event on Friday featuring CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon.

written.headline: Torus raises $500M to build modular container-sized AI data centers
written.summary: Salt Lake City-based energy storage startup Torus raised a $500 million Series C round led by Magnetar to launch its new Foundry product, which packs power, storage, cooling, networking, and AI computing into shipping container-sized units. The modular units range in size from one to 20 megawatts and are designed to run AI inference tasks at existing business and factory sites.

written.headline: Edelbyte emerges from stealth with $70M for AI agent data platform
written.summary: Edelbyte emerged from stealth with $70 million in funding led by Sequoia and Quiet Capital to build a data analytics platform optimized for AI agents. The startup offers a unified platform combining search, analytics, vector, graph, and geospatial capabilities.
